# Evidence Ledger

> Confidence fades; evidence stays. The Awtsmoos.com release follows observed files, commands, tests, commits, and public rays.

## Repository baseline

- Repository: `/Users/awtsmoos/work/awtsmoos.com`.
- Initial branch: `main`.
- Initial HEAD: `e5e4909d1c055795c77740a2ad37ff3250dd42d8`.
- Initial `origin/main`: aligned with HEAD when inspected.
- Extensive unrelated dirty work exists in Android Emulator, Nesher Studio, Piano, plus unrelated MitzvahWorld handoff work.

## Architecture evidence

- `src/core/proceduralLanguage/` contains canonical semantic language, validators, definitions, compiler registry, artifact planning/execution.
- `UniversalSemanticKernel` exposes definition/compiler/planning/compile capabilities.
- `ProceduralCompilerCapabilityRegistry` keeps public descriptors separate from private executors.
- `ProceduralDefinition` contains fluent immutable authored semantics and hash/provenance behavior.
- `src/core/proceduralPortal/` provides world orchestration and imports `universalApi/world.js` directly.
- `src/core/universalApi/` provides command registry, runtime projection, history, events, world documents, Reality/textures definitions, API contract and explorer.
- `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi()` is the existing transactional universal world API.
- Root `src/index.js` re-exports `core/universalApi/index.js` and Procedural Portal.

## Historical design evidence

- Aug. 26 world-data plans explicitly choose portable semantic data plus compiler plugins and a simple `createAwtsmoos`-style doorway.
- Later compiler-federation/Portal plans evolved that design rather than replacing it.
- Aug. 31 authored-semantics plan implemented quantity/provenance/identity/fluent authoring but left verification/closure work in its REMAINING_WORK.

## Deployment evidence

- Repository contains `scripts/bhRelease.mjs`, immutable deploy helpers, `publishLocalSnapshot`, canonical server activation, production authority, nginx and deployment contract tests.
- Exact current command, target and public URL remain to be verified before release.

## Evidence still required

- new source behavior tests;
- inherited semantic-debt verification;
- compatibility regression results;
- browser/runtime results;
- final HEAD/upstream/staged diff;
- pushed GitHub SHA;
- deployed SHA/version;
- fresh-browser public URL proof.
